name: zinc finger MYM-type containing 2

function.text: ZMYM2 encodes zinc finger MYM-type protein 2. Annotated molecular activities include zinc ion binding and ubiquitin conjugating enzyme binding. It participates in negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription.

germline.text: Strong or definitive GenCC assertions link constitutional variants to syndromic complex neurodevelopmental disorder (autosomal dominant); neurodevelopmental-craniofacial syndrome with variable renal and cardiac abnormalities (autosomal dominant).

somatic.text: Reported somatic alteration contexts include Myeloid/lymphoid neoplasm with tyrosine kinase fusion. The alteration class and exact variant must be assessed in the disease context.

germline_associations.mechanism: Autosomal dominant; definitive GenCC assertion from ClinGen. Allele-specific mechanism requires review.

function.text: ZMYM2 encodes zinc finger MYM-type protein 2. It participates in negative regulation of DNA-templated transcription. Functional annotations also associate the protein with ubiquitin conjugating enzyme binding.
